asset: bridge-freedom-parkway.glb: procedural facsimile of John Lewis Freedom Parkway and Stone Mountain Trail over the Eastside Trail for the beltline-eastside level, one node per LOD (lod0, lod1), shared materials and tiling textures.
tool: Blender 5.2.3 LTS, headless (blender -b -P), glTF 2.0 exporter with Draco
source: scripts/blender/landmarks.py: footprint walls with bays of recessed windows, piers, belts, cornice, parapet, roof, and props, all from code. No photo pixels, scans of the real building, mesh extraction, or logos.
prompt: None. The script and sites.json are the full recipe.
credits: No paid generation credits (Meshy not used).
textures: lm_brick_*, lm_trim_*: the CC0 Poly Haven scans in assets/landmarks/textures/ (see its provenance.json), recolored in code for the buff brick and concrete; lm_window_*, lm_fence_color, lm_far_pcm_color: painted in code by landmarks.py.

references.title: Gathering space beneath Freedom Parkway along the Atlanta BeltLine Eastside Trail
references.author: Marc Merlin
references.use: Visual reference for shapes and colors only; no pixels of the photo are in the asset.

data.attribution: Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Heights: Overture Maps Foundation. Elevation: USGS 3DEP. Street names: City of Atlanta Department of City Planning
data.deckHeights: terrain.js bridgeDeck() on the OSM span

placement.axes: glTF axes = level axes (+x east, +y up, +z south)
